Mr. Abdul Ghaffar Narejo advocate files vakalatnama on
body: behalf of respondents No.13 and 14, which is taken on record. The grievance of the petitioner is only that his application, which is pending before the respondent No.1, has not been decided. Learned A.A.G submits that it is right of the petitioner that his application be decided in accordance with law. In view of such a position instant petition is disposed of while directing the respondent No.1 to decide application of the petitioner, available at page No.27 of court file, within 30 days after hearing all concerned.
